About Us

VatSnap is a free, unofficial VAT rate calculator built for small online sellers — Etsy, Shopify, Amazon and independent shops selling into the EU.

Why we built this

EU VAT rates live scattered across official tables that are hard to use at checkout speed. We wanted one fast page per country — standard rate, reduced rates, and a calculator preset to that country — covering all 27 EU members plus the UK for reference (28 pages total).

Where the numbers come from

Every rate on this site is bundled at build time from the open-source eu-vat-rates-data npm package, which tracks the European Commission's Taxes in Europe Database (TEDB). No rate is ever typed by hand into the UI — the calculator reads the dataset directly, so updates to the package flow straight through on the next build. Rates shown were last verified 2026-08-23.

Important disclaimer

VatSnap is a guidance tool, not tax advice. VAT treatment depends on place of supply, customer status, product category, thresholds and exemptions that this calculator cannot know. Always confirm rates and filing obligations with a qualified accountant or the official EU TEDB source before invoicing or filing. See our Terms.

Cost & privacy

The site is fully static — no backend, no database, no accounts, no tracking. Calculations happen in your browser. Read the full Privacy Policy.

Get in touch

Found an error or want a feature? Head to our Contact page — rate corrections with an official source link are especially welcome.
